name: Kibookal Pichwai Devotional Tableau
composition: A vertical devotional tableau inside an ornate cusped temple-arch border; a central sacred subject (deity, tree-of-life, or peacock) on a deep indigo night ground; symmetrical lotus, cows/deer, birds in flight, full moon above; dense gold-outlined ornament filling every margin.
visual_traits: antique gold + ochre + terracotta + sage palette
tree-of-life, peacock, deer, lotus, full moon
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal Pichwai devotional tableau of [SUBJECT] in the Nathdwara temple-hanging tradition: a vertical composition framed by an ornate cusped golden temple-arch border, [SUBJECT] centred on a deep indigo midnight ground, surrounded by a flowering tree-of-life, lotus ponds, cows or deer, peacocks and birds in flight beneath a luminous full moon. Antique gold, ochre, terracotta, sage-green and ivory on midnight blue; fine gold outlines, flat devotional symmetry, dense sacred ornament in every margin. Reverent, luminous, hand-painted temple art.
negative: no phone UI, no status bar, no Instagram interface, no app chrome, no caption text, no screenshot border; no photoreal, no 3D, no flat vector, no Western cartoon, no exact reference copy
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, motifs, ornament and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.

style_lock.medium: opaque gouache + gold on indigo cloth
style_lock.palette: deep indigo ground, antique gold, ochre, terracotta, sage, ivory
